summary: Sustainability surcharge applied to dedicated fallback while reserved capacity credit missing on provisional invoice
description:
Issue summary:
Customer GreenCart AI reports a provisional invoice generated 2026-03-09 that includes a sustainability surcharge line and omits the reserved-capacity prorated credit they should receive for dedicated capacity fallback hours on 2026-03-07 23:00-2026-03-08 03:00 UTC.

Impact:
- Customer provisional balance shows a +$1,420 surcharge and no -$600 reserved credit for the fallback window.
- Customer is flagged for autopay failure threshold because the provisional balance exceeds their forecasted budget.

Environment:
- Production routed through dedicated pool us-west-2 with hosted fallback on eu-west-1 during GP-failover.
- Affected org: org_0x7e5c (GreenCart AI).

Steps to reproduce (customer workflow):
1) Trigger sustained load on dedicated pool using a mixed-embed+chat workload (customer test harness attached).
2) Client experienced transient scheduling delay; smart-routing triggered host fallback to eu-west-1 (hosted).
3) Billing postbacks show two events for the fallback window: one hosted fallback surcharge and one reserved-capacity usage line but postback reconciler shows missing reserve-credit application.

Observed logs and artifacts:
- Customer-provided invoice screenshot (invoice_2026-03-09.png).
- Postback messages from 2026-03-07 23:05 UTC onwards (attached).
- Console runbook link: https://confluence.redwoodinc/ops/billing-fallback-runbook

Requested outcome:
- Explain why sustainability surcharge applied for fallback window and why reserved-capacity prorated credit not present on provisional invoice.
- Apply provisional adjustment or issue waiver pending root cause.
comments: 2026-03-10 09:12 - Asha Patel: Opened ticket after customer called Support line complaining about provisional invoice surge. Customer has supplied postback logs and invoice screenshot.
2026-03-10 10:01 - Diego Ramos: Assigned to billing ops. I will triage postbacks and check reserved-credit reconcile job for that window.
2026-03-10 15:27 - Customer (Elena Martins, GreenCart): We confirmed the dedicated pool was healthy; fallback happened automatically. We need the provisional adjustment ASAP to avoid payment failure.
2026-03-11 08:40 - Diego Ramos: Found SRE note indicating a routing metadata tag change during the failover that may have caused the reserve-credit matcher to skip the fallback events. Investigating.
2026-03-12 11:05 - Finance (Marta Kovacs): Holding provisional waiver approval pending final reconcile. Requested detailed charge breakdown and guarantee of not repeating.
investigation_notes: 2026-03-10 11:00 - Reconciler trace (job id: rc-20260307-23): two postbacks for fallback window present, but reserve-credit application pipeline returned 204 for reserve tag lookup.
Correlation: routing metadata for fallback events was tagged as 'fallback_v2' after a canary alias rename that rolled out 2026-03-07 22:58 UTC (deploy: github.com/redwoodinc/routing-service@c7a1d9).

Hypothesis: reserve-credit matcher expects tags 'dedicated-fallback' or 'reserved-fallback' and does not match new 'fallback_v2' tag. Sustainability surcharge is applied by hosted-tariff logic and matched by region tag, so surcharge applied correctly to hosted fallback consumption.
Evidence: Reconciler logs show message: 'reserve-credit-matcher: no match for tag fallback_v2 -> skipping credit apply' (see /var/logs/billing/reconciler/rc-2026-03-07.log lines 412-427).

Impact scope: Preliminary scan shows ~12 orgs affected in same time window that had traffic routed through the canary edge. GreenCart AI reserved credit expected: $600 (4 hours * $150/hr reserve discount). Sustainability surcharge unexpectedly applied because hosted tariff includes environmental surcharge flag for eu-west-1 and was not suppressed during reserved-credit reconciliation.
resolution_notes:
Workaround/fix applied 2026-03-12: Reconciler hotfix deployed to add fallback_v2 to reserve-credit matcher allowed list (PR: github.com/redwoodinc/billing-reconciler/pull/321). Backfilled reconcile job reprocessed 2026-03-07 postbacks and applied reserved credits for affected orgs; provisional invoices updated for GreenCart AI and three other orgs.

Follow-up actions: Added unit test to prevent tag-regression, and a migration task to map legacy/new fallback tag aliases (ticket INT-4221). Finance issued provisional waiver for sustainability surcharge for GreenCart AI while backfill completed; waiver id WAIVER-2026-03-12-07 applied.

Customer communication: 2026-03-12 16:00 - Diego Ramos (Support) emailed Elena Martins with explanation, the provisional adjustment amount ($600 credit plus waived $1,420 surcharge), and confirmation that final invoice will reflect backfill. Customer requested a short postmortem; SRE/Eng to prepare by 2026-03-18.
